_source: Boston 311 Department Map (team artifact), built from Analyze Boston 311 Service Requests 2024 (306,756 cases). Queue checklists are suggestions; workload is 2024 legacy-system data; public data shows only the final queue. Spot-checked against the raw 2024 data on 2026-10-24.

_fields.departments: code -> {name, what, need[] (required info), help[] (optional info), can[], cant[]}
_fields.workload: {dep: code -> stats, q: 'DEP|queue' -> stats}; stats = {perDay, median (days to close), p90 (days), sla (city deadline, days), ontime (%), open (count still open), peak (busiest month 1-12)}. Ignore 'own' here: its meaning is undocumented.
_fields.quality: departments: code -> {total, closed, bad, dup, miss, own, inv, noev}; queues: code -> [{q, ...same, types[], ex[] example closures}]. bad/dup/miss/own/inv/noev are % of closed: no-fix total, duplicate, missing info, wrong owner, invalid, no evidence found.
_fields.actions: {dep, q} -> [[action taken, % of closures]] mined from closure comments

For bulk items: the list of items and the pickup date
help: Photo that shows the surroundings so the crew can find it
